questions.stem:
The stem-and-leaf diagram below shows the distribution of heights in cm of 32 students. It is found that three records less than 150 cm are incorrect. Each of them should be 10 cm greater than the original record. Find the change in each of the following statistics after correcting the three records:

Source clarification: four entries are below 150 cm; only three are corrected. Part (d) has two possible outcomes.

(a) the mean,

(b) the median,

(c) the mode,

(d) the range,

(e) the interquartile range.
questions.stemZh:
下列莖葉圖顯示 32 名學生的身高（cm）分布。低於 150 cm 的三項記錄均有誤，每項應比原記錄多 10 cm。求更正後下列各統計量的改變：

原稿說明：圖中有四項低於 150 cm，僅更正其中三項；(d) 有兩個可能結果。

(a) 平均數，

(b) 中位數，

(c) 眾數，

(d) 分佈域，

(e) 四分位距。
questions.solution: (a) +0.9375 cm; (b) 0; (c) unchanged (157 cm); (d) −1 cm or 0, depending on which records are corrected; (e) −1 cm.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 增加 0.9375 cm；(b) 不變；(c) 眾數不變，仍為 157 cm；(d) 減少 1 cm 或不變，視乎更正哪三項記錄；(e) 四分位距減少 1 cm。

questions.stem:
The bar chart below shows the distribution of the most favourite fruits of the students in a group. It is given that each student has only one most favourite fruit.

If a student is randomly selected from the group, the probability that the most favourite fruit is apple is \(\frac3{20}\).

(a) Find k.

(b) (i)

Suppose that the above distribution is represented by a pie chart. Find the angle of the sector representing that the most favourite fruit is orange.

(ii) Some new students now join the group and the most favourite fruit of each of these students is orange. Will the angle of the sector representing that the most favourite fruit is orange be doubled? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
下列棒形圖顯示一組學生最喜愛的水果分布。每名學生只有一種最喜愛的水果。

若隨機選取一名學生，其最喜愛的水果為蘋果的概率為 \(\frac3{20}\)。

(a) 求 k。

(b) (i)

若以圓形圖表示上述分布，求代表最喜愛水果為橙的扇形角度。

(ii) 一些新學生加入，每人最喜愛的水果均為橙。代表橙的扇形角度會否增加一倍？解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) k=8. (b)(i) 45°; (ii) No. Originally there are 40 students, of whom 5 prefer orange. Doubling the sector requires (5+n)/(40+n)=1/4, hence n=20/3, which is not an integer number of students.
questions.solutionZh: (a) k=8；(b)(i) 45°；(ii) 不會。原有 40 人，其中 5 人喜愛橙。若加入 n 人後角度加倍，須有 (5+n)/(40+n)=1/4，解得 n=20/3，並非整數人數。

(b) Estimate the mean and standard deviation of the distribution.

(c) Susan scores 76 in this test. Find her standard score.

(d) Another test is given to the same class of students. It is found that the mean and standard deviation of the scores in this second test are 58 and 10 respectively. Relative to her classmates, if Susan performs equally well in these two tests, estimate her score in the second test.
questions.stemZh:
圖中直方圖顯示一班 40 名學生的測驗成績分布。

68≤x<76 的棒形已按公開試原卷還原為頻數 11。

(a) 完成下表。

(b) 估計此分布的平均數及標準差。

(c) Susan 在此次測驗得 76 分。求她的標準分。

(d) 該班進行另一次測驗，平均數及標準差分別為 58 及 10。若相對於同學，Susan 在兩次測驗表現相同，估計她第二次的分數。
questions.solution: (a) Class marks: 48,56,64,72,80; frequencies: 3,9,15,11,2; missing classes: 60≤x<68, 76≤x<84. (b) Mean ≈64; σ ≈8. (c) ≈1.5. (d) ≈73 marks.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 組中點依次為 48、56、64、72、80；頻數依次為 3、9、15、11、2。欠缺的組別為 60≤x<68 及 76≤x<84。(b) 平均數約 64，標準差約 8；(c) 標準分約 1.5；(d) 第二次測驗的分數約 73 分。

The stem-and-leaf diagram shows the ages of the players of a football team:

(a) Find the mean, the median and the range of the ages of the players of the football team.

(b) As the two oldest players leave the team, three new players join the football team. After the three players join the football team, the manager of the team finds that the mean of the ages of the players of the football team is the same as the mean found in (a).

(i) Find the mean age of the three new players.

(ii) Furthermore, the manager finds that the median and the range of the ages of the players of the football team are the same as the median and the range found in (a) respectively. Write down two sets of possible ages of the three new players.
questions.stemZh:
莖葉圖顯示一支足球隊球員的年齡：

(a) 求球員年齡的平均數、中位數及分佈域。

(b) 兩名最年長球員離隊，另有三名新球員加入。領隊發現新隊伍球員年齡的平均數與 (a) 所求相同。

(i) 求三名新球員年齡的平均數。

(ii) 領隊亦發現中位數及分佈域分別與 (a) 所求相同。寫出三名新球員年齡的兩組可能數值。
questions.solutionZh: (a) 平均年齡 25 歲，中位數 26 歲，分佈域 13 歲；(b)(i) 新球員的平均年齡為 29 歲；(ii) 例如 (25,31,31) 或 (26,30,31) 歲。

questions.stem:
The revision times (in minutes) of 19 students are represented by the stem-and-leaf diagram in the figure. It is known that the mean revision time is (40+b) minutes.

(a) Find a and b.

(b) Find the standard deviation of the revision times for the students.

(c) The revision times of 2 more students are added. If both the range and the mean do not change after the inclusion of the 2 data, find the range of possible values of the standard deviation of the revision times for the 21 students.
questions.stemZh:
莖葉圖顯示 19 名學生的溫習時間（分鐘）。已知平均溫習時間為 (40+b) 分鐘。

(a) 求 a 及 b。

(b) 求學生溫習時間的標準差。

(c) 加入另外兩名學生的溫習時間，分佈域及平均數均不變。求這 21 名學生溫習時間的標準差的可能數值範圍。
questions.solution: (a) a=1, b=3. (b) σ ≈12.19 min. (c) 11.596≤σ≤12.728 min (rounded endpoints). The two added times sum to 86; the minimum is attained at (43,43) and the maximum at (26,60).
questions.solutionZh: (a) a=1，b=3；(b) 標準差約 12.19 分鐘；(c) 標準差介乎約 11.596 至 12.728 分鐘，包含兩端。新增兩項時間之和為 86，最小值在 (43,43) 取得，最大值在 (26,60) 取得。

The data below show the percentages of customers who bought newspaper A from a magazine stall in city H for five days randomly selected in a certain week:

62%　63%　55%　62%　58%

(a) Find the median and the mean of the above data.

(b) Let a% and b% be the percentages of customers who bought newspaper A from the stall for the other two days in that week. The two percentages are combined with the above data to form a set of seven data.

(i) Write down the least possible value of the median of the combined set of seven data.

(ii) It is known that the median and the mean of the combined set of seven data are the same as that found in (a). Write down one pair of possible values of a and b.

(c) The stall-keeper claims that since the median and the mean found in (a) exceed 50%, newspaper A has the largest market share among the newspapers in city H. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
以下為某星期隨機選取五天中，在 H 市一報攤購買報紙 A 的顧客百分率：

62%　63%　55%　62%　58%

(a) 求上述數據的中位數及平均數。

(b) 設該星期其餘兩天的百分率為 a% 及 b%。把這兩項與上述數據合併成七項數據。

(i) 寫出合併數據中位數的最小可能值。

(ii) 已知合併後中位數及平均數分別與 (a) 所求相同。寫出 a 及 b 的一組可能值。

(c) 報攤店主聲稱，由於 (a) 的中位數及平均數超過 50%，報紙 A 在 H 市的報紙市場佔有率最高。你是否同意？解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) Median 62%; mean 60%. (b)(i) 58%; (ii) e.g. a=57, b=63. (c) Disagree: five days at a single stall do not establish city-wide newspaper market shares.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 中位數 62%，平均數 60%；(b)(i) 最小中位數為 58%；(ii) 例如 a=57，b=63；(c) 不同意。單一報攤五天的樣本，不能代表全市報章的市場佔有率。

questions.stemZh:

questions.solution: (a) Mean 55 kg; median 52 kg; range 39 kg. (b) 52 kg and 80 kg.
